narration: Synthetic English narration, en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural. MXI is pronounced as three letters. New script and subtitles.
music: Original instrumental score; no narration between 163 and 186.333 seconds.

result.interpretation: moving minus target, world metres; RGB must confirm correspondence. Radius is conservative from four marked inner-rim points. Grip and cup-axis are visual estimates.

planning.path_scope: Forward-kinematic projection of recorded commanded joint targets, using the ARX URDF, standard robot base poses, fixed head calibration and nominal 150 mm grasp-center reference. Not a measured object path or a reconstruction of the rejected candidate.

wrist_guide: Guide reconstructed with verified fixed camera-to-link6 transform and nominal gripper opening from executed-command ledger. It is a geometric reference, not measured aperture/contact. Alignment glow is editorial.
icl_diagram: Verified J18/H15 and B6 time-anchor rules. Timeline numbers use the audited Stack Bowls record. Thumbnail footage is from separate successful Stack Bowls episodes and illustrates the format; it is not the exact TRAIN/LIVE bundle of that audit.
image_quality: Native 4K typography/composition. Recorded camera streams originate at 640x480 and are upscaled.

original_icl.scope: Original paper, 30-task overall; strongest reported baseline; separate from current evaluation.

current.scope: Team self-evaluation; Q0 revised-rule reference communicated to team; not an independently verified leaderboard ranking.

footprint.scope: Preliminary authored-text audit; excludes demonstrations and dynamic context; task-local/runtime variants not fully audited.

ablation.scope: Exploratory paired runs, seed 0; 8 layouts and 32 scored trajectories overall; post-hoc L27 excluded from primary tubes chart.

triangulation_diagram: Recorded L40 footage. Head-camera ray is cross-projected into the left-wrist image, and left-wrist ray into the head image, using reconstructed standard-scene calibration. Own-camera rays project to their target pixels. Luminous paths and particles are editorial emphasis, not uncertainty bounds. A real RGB crop and depth ruler replace the separate ray diagram. Original two-view data retained; occluded right-wrist recording excluded.
planner_diagram: Recorded L5 footage with luminous projected command paths, sampled command markers, real rejected/passed preview receipts and recorded joint values/traces. Colors, glow, scanning and pass/fail marks are editorial effects. No virtual robot mesh or synthetic scene. Rejected-route geometry is not invented.

video_alignment.planner: Continuous native execution mapped by video_frame = command_step + 37. Offset inferred from 591 source video frames and final step 553, then checked visually at source seconds 4, 6, 8 and 10. Editorial alignment, not a per-frame simulator timestamp proof.

visual_revision.wrist: High-contrast nominal grasp reticle, editorial alignment pulse, and same-RGB enlarged detail. Highlight is not a measured contact or success detector.
visual_revision.triangulation: Calibrated cross-projections with a luminous core and particle flow; matching two views, with occluded third view excluded.
visual_revision.planner: Translucent simplified wrist-and-finger outlines projected from FK at recorded joint targets 105, 125, 145, 165 and 185. Nominal aperture; not a new simulated robot or reconstructed rejected route.
